samples.scenario: Publicly accessible Google Cloud Storage bucket exposing confidential financial reports due to a misconfigured IAM policy binding allUsers to roles/storage.objectViewer.

technical_data.Sample_HTTP_GET_Request_to_GCS_Object:
GET /fin-reports-2024/Q1_Financial_Report_2024.pdf HTTP/1.1
Host: storage.googleapis.com
User-Agent: curl/7.79.1
Accept: */*
technical_data.Example_Sensitive_Data_Snippet_from_PDF_:
%PDF-1.7
% Confidential Financial Report Q1 2024
Account: 0987654321
Revenue: $12,345,678
Expenses: $9,876,543
Net Profit: $2,469,135

Security_Posture_Scan_Tool_Output.details: Bucket allows public read access to all users
Security_Posture_Scan_Tool_Output.recommendation: Remove allUsers binding and restrict to authorized service accounts or principals

indicators: IAM policy binding 'allUsers' to roles/storage.objectViewer
GCP Audit logs showing unauthenticated principalEmail accessing storage.objects.list
HTTP GET requests for bucket objects without authorization headers
Presence of confidential financial data in publicly accessible PDF reports
Cloud security posture tool flagging public read access on GCS bucket
samples.detection_method: Use automated GCP CSPM tools to identify IAM bindings granting roles/storage.objectViewer to allUsers or allAuthenticatedUsers. Correlate with Audit Logs for unauthenticated or anonymous access methods (storage.objects.list and storage.objects.get). Perform scheduled content inspection for sensitive keywords in objects metadata and content. Alert on any public access to sensitive buckets.
relevant_mitre_techniques: T1530 - Data from Cloud Storage Object
T1565.001 - Data from Information Repositories: Cloud Storage Object

samples.scenario: Publicly accessible Azure Blob Storage container exposing internal HR data due to a misconfigured container-level access policy set to 'Blob (anonymous read access for blobs only)'.

technical_data.Sample_HTTP_GET_Request_to_Azure_Blob:
GET /hr-data/employee_records_2024.csv HTTP/1.1
Host: hrstorageaccount.blob.core.windows.net
User-Agent: wget/1.20.3 (linux-gnu)
Accept: */*

Security_Posture_Scan_Tool_Output.details: Container access level set to 'blob', allowing anonymous read access to blobs
Security_Posture_Scan_Tool_Output.recommendation: Set container access level to 'private' and enforce RBAC for blob access

indicators: Azure Blob container access level set to 'blob' allowing anonymous blob read
Azure Activity logs showing anonymous GetBlob operations
HTTP GET requests to blob storage endpoints without Authorization headers
Exposure of internal HR PII data in blob files
Security posture scan reporting public access on blob container
samples.detection_method: Use Azure Security Center and Azure Policy to detect containers with public access level 'blob' or 'container'. Monitor Azure Activity Logs for anonymous or unauthenticated calls to blob Get operations. Periodically inspect blob content for sensitive data patterns such as PII. Alert on any anonymous blob reads from sensitive containers.
relevant_mitre_techniques: T1530 - Data from Cloud Storage Object

Implement content scanning for sensitive keys or credentials using regex pattern matching in bucket objects.
